recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast male portrait featuring warm, directional lighting that leaves half the face in deep shadow, paired with heavy, distressed sans-serif typography that interacts with the subject's shoulder and the vertical edge.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones against a deep black background
Vertical text alignment contrasting with horizontal facial features
Distressed texture in type mirroring the rugged facial hair texture
Tight cropping that creates intimacy and intensity

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The face occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, cropped tightly at the forehead and chin.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The illuminated eye and bridge of the nose serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the lit side of the face, down to the horizontal text on the chest, then upward along the vertical text on the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space occupies the upper right quadrant, providing a backdrop for the vertical text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep shadows and black background for depth.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm amber and peach skin tones for the subject.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for the typography to ensure legibility against dark areas.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the lit skin and the black background; low saturation in the clothing to keep focus on the face.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earth tones and monochromatic blacks/whites

characterSpecificRedesigns: Introduction of small 'nicks' and missing pixels along the edges of glyphs to simulate old woodblock printing.

composition.overlap: Bleeds off the top and bottom edges

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in two different orientations and scales.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed proportions.
Captures the rugged, weathered aesthetic naturally.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a tight, high-contrast portrait of a man with short hair and a beard. Use warm, low-key lighting from the left side, leaving the right side of his face and the background in deep shadow. He should be wearing a simple white v-neck shirt. The crop should be very close, cutting off the top of the head.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, heavy, condensed sans-serif text in an off-white color. Place one word horizontally across the chest area with a distressed texture. Place a second word vertically along the right edge, rotated 90 degrees counter-clockwise, with a slightly more muted color.

verificationChecks: Is the vertical text rotated correctly along the right edge?
Is the crop tight enough to feel intimate?

adjustableVariables: Amount of distress on the lettering
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact placement of texture nicks in the font
postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the background
Ensure the skin tones feel natural and warm
Verify the vertical text bleeds off the edges correctly
Confirm the shadow areas are truly black
recipe.reuseFormula: Tight Chiaroscuro Portrait + Distressed Condensed Sans-Serif + Vertical Margin Text
